items.review_rationale: Read discrete-time filtration as nested sequence of sub-sigma-algebras F_n⊆F with monotone inclusion for all ordered indices n≤m.

references.context: For each indices n≤m, every event measurable by time n is included in F_m.

references.disposition: Equality F_n=F_m is allowed for some n<m.

items.review_rationale: Read proper k-vertex-coloring as function to k color labels with inequality on endpoints of every simple-graph edge, without requiring use of all labels.

references.phrase: finite set of k color labels
references.context: Label set indexed 1 through positive integer k.

references.disposition: A proper k-coloring may employ fewer than k colors.

items.review_rationale: Read stochastic process as family of measurable S-valued random variables over one probability space and shared measurable state space, indexed by arbitrary index set.

references.context: Family of measurable functions from Ω into common state space E for all i∈I.

references.disposition: Index set I may be arbitrary, and no adaptedness or independence is part of the bare process definition.

items.review_rationale: Read abelian group as group whose operation is commutative for every ordered pair of elements, preserving all group axioms via parent definition.

references.context: For all a,b∈G, multiplication can be reversed without changing its result.

references.phrase: commutativity is additional to group axioms
references.disposition: Associativity, identity and inverses come from group definition.
